children: Sun Communities released an investor presentation outlining portfolio metrics, guidance upgrades and progress toward an all-cash UK sale.
Investor presentation made available Sept 9, 2026 and posted on Sun Communities' investor site.
Guidance raised: FY26E Core FFO per share midpoint to $7.02 and North America same-property NOI midpoint to 4.9%.
2Q26 results: Core FFO per share $1.84 and North America same-property NOI growth 6.0%; 3Q26E Core FFO midpoint $2.28.
Balance sheet strength: net debt/TTM EBITDA 3.9x, 100% fixed-rate debt, investment grade ratings (BBB+/Baa2).
Strategic actions: ~$360m YTD share repurchases, ~$700m repurchase capacity remaining, and expected all-cash UK sale to close 2H 2026.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Sun Communities posts investor presentation, updates guidance and highlights UK sale progress
